skills.name: Razor Wire
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

skills.name: Bind
skills.desc:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers.
When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Ultimate, she gains 1 Burning Tether Point.
Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare.

skills.name: Garrote - First Form
skills.desc:
When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: Garrote - Second Form
skills.desc:
When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: Arc Step
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Piercing Ambush
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Strangling Reversal
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG; When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Fierce Blade
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Silent Protection
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Course Disruption
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Evelyn slashes with Lunalux Garrote, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Locked Position
skills.desc:
Before entering Binding Seal, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Fire DMG.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Binding Sunder - First Form
skills.desc:
After entering Binding Seal, press or hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Binding Sunder - Final Form
skills.desc:
After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Binding Seal will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press [Basic Attack] to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Basic Attack's 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Lunalux - Snare
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
skills.desc:
While under the Dance of Awakened Fire state, and when Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

skills.name: Entangle
skills.desc: Upon entering Binding Seal, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by 12.5%. After leaving Binding Seal, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in Binding Seal, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form.

skills.name: Ambush Point
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Evelyn's Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's CRIT Rate is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her Chain Attack and Ultimate increases to 125% of the original value.

cons.name: Dreamweave
cons.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1500 Decibels. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.

cons.name: Dance of Fire
cons.desc: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

cons.name: Metamorphosis
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

cons.name: Fate's Melody
cons.desc: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

cons.name: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

cons.name: Bond of Light and Shadow
cons.desc: When activating her Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits enemies with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, an additional Lunalux Garrote will be released for a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of Evelyn's ATK. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. The number of triggers will be refreshed each time Shadowstring Edge is gained.

main: 火属性伤害加成、穿透率 > 攻击力百分比
rec.sub: 暴击率、暴击伤害 > 攻击力百分比、穿透值
